title: Models (M8)
brief: Models screen of goop (/models), local llama.cpp servers only. Title breadcrumb; no key-hint line under the header. Problems first: a banner under the title (⚠ Qwen not responding · restarting 2/3 · matching paused, chat still works, r restart on the right; 2px --error edge on --background-panel). Memory map like btop/nvtop: one bar for VRAM 8 GB · RX 7700S (Vulkan) (Qwen 5.7 · Embeddings 0.6 · free 1.7) and one for RAM 30 GB (gpt-oss-20b 12.1 · Reranker 0.6 · system 1.5 · free 15.8), labels after each bar in segment order; model segments all --secondary, separated by a one-cell gap, system --border, free --background-element. Two panes: on the left the models grouped by where they run (GPU · RX 7700S: Profile & matching Qwen3.5-9B, Embeddings Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B; CPU · RAM: Chat · Orchestrator gpt-oss-20b, Security gpt-oss-safeguard-20b, Reranker bge-reranker-v2-m3), two lines each (role + state: ⚠ error, ● ready, ◐ loading, ○ on demand, ↓ update 32%; then model · quant · size · tok/s · reasoning), Qwen selected; on the right the selected model with tabs Info · Log · Benchmark (Log active): last log lines as dim plain text behind a │ gutter, what goop did as a goop turn, and an LM Studio-style estimate previewing d (move to CPU → +5.7 GB RAM · ~9 tok/s (now 41) · fits, ↵ confirm · esc cancel). One status line with the models focus mode, the hints of the focused list (↑↓ move · r restart · d device · ctrl+r reasoning · [ ] tabs · esc back) and ◐ restarting qwen 2/3 │ ↓ 32% │ ? help. Below the screen: the update download, the Benchmark tab results and the chat status line alert chip that leads here. Model startup never blocks the TUI.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Problem banner, memory map and a side list grouped by device plus one tabbed detail panel with a device-switch estimate; memory pressure and where each model runs are visible at a glance, but the detail shows one model and one tab at a time, the memory map costs three rows, same-color segments need the labels, and the screen hides the chat
